preferences.name: hiddenApps
preferences.title: Hidden Applications
preferences.description: IDs of applications that are not shown in search

name: Selected Text
description: Shows the text selected in the window you were in when the launcher opened, with its word count. The actions on the text come from the other plugins.

name: Calculator
description: Evaluate math expressions and convert units, currencies, timestamps, colors and sizes right in the search bar

preferences.name: unitSystem
preferences.title: Unit system
preferences.description: Which units are suggested first when you type a quantity such as “10 km”.

preferences.name: chineseUnits
preferences.title: Suggest Chinese units
preferences.description: Also suggest Chinese market units (斤, 两, 亩, 尺, 寸, 里…). They can always be typed.

preferences.name: significantDigits
preferences.title: Significant digits
preferences.description: How many significant digits unit conversions show (1–30).

preferences.name: dpi
preferences.title: Screen DPI
preferences.description: Pixels per inch for converting px to physical units such as pt, mm and in.

preferences.name: remBase
preferences.title: Root font size (px)
preferences.description: Pixels per rem and em.

preferences.name: currencyProvider
preferences.title: Exchange rates
preferences.description: Where currency rates come from. They are downloaded at most every 6 hours, need no API key, and are kept for offline use. Rates by Exchange Rate API (open.er-api.com, about 160 currencies, daily) or Frankfurter (European Central Bank, about 30 currencies, working days).

preferences.name: currencies
preferences.title: Currencies
preferences.description: ISO codes of the currencies an amount such as “100 usd” is converted to.

preferences.name: yenMeansJPY
preferences.title: ¥ means Japanese yen
preferences.description: Read ¥ and ￥ as Japanese yen (JPY) instead of Chinese yuan (CNY).

name: Clipboard History
description: Search and paste everything you copied.

preferences.name: maxItems
preferences.title: Maximum items
preferences.description: Older unpinned items are removed. 0 keeps everything.

preferences.name: maxDays
preferences.title: Keep items for (days)
preferences.description: Unpinned items not used for this many days are removed. 0 keeps them forever.

preferences.name: recordImages
preferences.title: Record images
preferences.description: Save copied images in the history.

preferences.name: ignoreApps
preferences.title: Ignored applications
preferences.description: Executable names whose copies are never recorded, e.g. KeePassXC.exe on Windows or KeePassXC on macOS.

name: World Clock
description: The time in over 30,000 cities. Type “time” and a city, country or time zone in the main search. City data: GeoNames (geonames.org), CC BY 4.0.

preferences.name: prefixes
preferences.title: Search prefixes
preferences.description: Words that start a world clock search in the main search, as in “time tokyo”.

preferences.name: cities
preferences.title: Cities
preferences.description: Cities listed after your favorites: English or Chinese names, abbreviations (nyc) or IANA time zones (Asia/Tokyo).

preferences.name: hour24
preferences.title: 24-hour clock
preferences.description: Show times as 14:30 instead of 2:30 PM.

preferences.name: showSeconds
preferences.title: Show seconds
preferences.description: Show the seconds, so the clocks visibly tick.

name: Timers
description: Countdowns and reminders with a notification when they end. Type “timer 25m” or “remind 15:30 meeting” in the main search.

preferences.name: prefixes
preferences.title: Timer prefixes
preferences.description: Words that start a countdown in the main search, as in “timer 25m tea”.

preferences.name: remindPrefixes
preferences.title: Reminder prefixes
preferences.description: Words that set a reminder in the main search, as in “remind 15:30 meeting”.

preferences.name: sound
preferences.title: Play a sound
preferences.description: Notifications of ended timers make a sound.

preferences.name: historySize
preferences.title: History
preferences.description: How many ended and cancelled timers to keep (0 to 100).

preferences.name: hour24
preferences.title: 24-hour clock
preferences.description: Show times as 15:30 rather than 3:30 PM.

name: Files
description: Actions for the folder you are working in when the launcher opens: open a terminal or VS Code there, create folders and text files, copy paths, compress and hash files.

name: File Search (Everything)
description: Find files and folders on this computer instantly with voidtools Everything.

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Maximum results
preferences.description: Number of files shown for a search (at most 1000).

preferences.name: matchPath
preferences.title: Match full path
preferences.description: Match the search text against the whole path, not just the name.

preferences.name: showInRoot
preferences.title: Show files in the main search
preferences.description: List up to 5 matching files below apps and commands for searches of 3 or more characters.

preferences.name: hideSystemFiles
preferences.title: Hide system files
preferences.description: Leave out files in Windows, program data, caches and package folders (node_modules, site-packages, …). When off they are listed after your own files.

preferences.name: extraLowPriorityPaths
preferences.title: Low-priority locations
preferences.description: Folders listed after your own files, like system files: a full path (D:\VMs) or a folder name matched anywhere (vendor, build).

name: Script Commands
description: Run your own scripts as commands (compatible with Raycast Script Commands).

preferences.name: directories
preferences.title: Script directories
preferences.description: Folders scanned for scripts (.ps1, .py, .js, .bat, .cmd, .sh) with @raycast metadata. %VAR% is expanded.

name: System
description: Lock, sleep, restart or shut down the computer, empty the Recycle Bin, toggle dark mode, change the volume, and open any Windows settings page or administrative tool.

name: Network Tools
description: IP addresses, ping, DNS lookups, ports and saved Wi-Fi networks. Type “ip”, “ping”, “dns”, “port”, “wifi” or “tracert” in the main search.

preferences.name: publicIP
preferences.title: Show public IP address
preferences.description: When you type “ip”, ask api.ipify.org (or ifconfig.me) for your public address. The answer is kept for 5 minutes; nothing is asked in the background.

preferences.name: pingCount
preferences.title: Ping count
preferences.description: Echo requests sent by Ping, unless you ping continuously.

name: Processes
description: Find running apps and processes, see their CPU and memory use, switch to them or end them. Type “ps ” (with a space), “kill” or “进程” in the main search.

preferences.name: prefixes
preferences.title: Prefixes
preferences.description: Words that list processes in the main search. “ps” needs a space after it; with “kill”, Enter ends the task. Leave empty to turn them off.

preferences.name: cpuMode
preferences.title: CPU use
preferences.description: Share of all processors (as in Task Manager), or of one processor (as in top: up to 100% per processor).

preferences.name: closeTimeout
preferences.title: Wait for apps to close (seconds)
preferences.description: End task asks an app to close and waits this long before offering to force it.

preferences.name: redactCommandLine
preferences.title: Hide secrets in command lines
preferences.description: Show values of options such as --password or --token as •••.

preferences.name: foregroundQuit
preferences.title: Offer to quit the app in front
preferences.description: “Quit <app>” in the search, and “Force quit” when the app in front is not responding.

name: Quicklinks & Web Search
description: Search the web with keywords (“g golang generics”, “bd 天气”), open typed URLs, and keep named links to websites, files, folders and programs. When nothing matches, the main search offers to search the web.

preferences.name: defaultEngine
preferences.title: Default search engine
preferences.description: Offered when the main search finds nothing good.

preferences.name: secondEngine
preferences.title: Second search engine
preferences.description: Also offered when the main search finds nothing good.

preferences.name: fallback
preferences.title: Offer a web search
preferences.description: When the main search finds nothing good, offer to search the web for the text.

preferences.name: openURLs
preferences.title: Open typed URLs
preferences.description: When the text is a web address (github.com/…, localhost:3000), offer to open it first.

preferences.name: suggestions
preferences.title: Search suggestions
preferences.description: Show the search engine’s suggestions while you type after a keyword (“g golang gen…”). What you type after the keyword is sent to that search engine. Text without a keyword is never sent.

name: AI
description: Chat with Claude in the launcher through your Claude Code CLI and subscription.

preferences.name: enabled
preferences.title: Use AI
preferences.description: Sends the questions you type in an AI chat to Claude through the Claude Code CLI installed on this computer, with your Claude subscription (no API key). Nothing is sent while this is off.

preferences.name: backend
preferences.title: Backend
preferences.description: The AI tool on this computer that answers. It must be installed and signed in.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: The Claude model that answers.

preferences.name: webSearch
preferences.title: Allow web search
preferences.description: Lets Claude search the web and read web pages to answer.

preferences.name: tools
preferences.title: Let AI use launcher plugins
preferences.description: Lets Claude search and run the launcher's plugins for you, for example to find an app, check a port or install a program. Actions that change something always ask you first. Claude gets no other access to this computer.

preferences.name: retentionDays
preferences.title: Keep chats for
preferences.description: Older chats are deleted from AI Chat History.

preferences.name: askFallback
preferences.title: Offer “Ask AI” when nothing matches
preferences.description: When the main search finds nothing good, its last entry asks AI about what you typed. Tab always does.

preferences.name: translateTo
preferences.title: Translate to
preferences.description: The language that “Translate” turns selected text into. Automatic: the language of golauncher; text already in that language is translated into English.

name: Background Tasks
description: Shows the background tasks of golauncher and its plugins with their output, and lets you stop or rerun them.

name: AI Activity
description: What AI clients did with your plugins.

name: Scoop
description: Search, install, update and remove apps with the Scoop package manager.
unavailable: Scoop is not installed. Get it from scoop.sh.

name: WinGet
description: Search, install, upgrade and remove apps with the Windows Package Manager (winget).
unavailable: WinGet is not installed. Install App Installer from the Microsoft Store.

name: Terminal & WSL
description: Your Windows Terminal profiles and WSL distributions in the root search: open them in a new window, a new tab, as administrator or in the current folder; set the default distribution, stop it, shut down or update WSL.
unavailable: Neither Windows Terminal nor a WSL distribution is installed
